geneal — default ablation (safety + diversity)

5056 genes (data/processed/depmap/panel_5k.txt) · 2 cell lines · 1 seeds · K=30 · AL 2×10 · τ-quantile=0.5 · contrast line ACH-001360 · acq=ucb

How to read this

Two analyses, two questions, two toxicity definitions.

Safety rules (Analysis A). • greedy: top-K predicted efficacy, no safety. • truncation · known: keep genes below the τ toxicity ceiling using the known toxicity (oracle limit). • truncation · predicted: same ceiling, but toxicity is learned by a GP. • EHVI: learned toxicity with a dual-objective EHVI acquisition. • random / farthest / cluster / info_div: prior-work / naive baselines (info_div = informativeness+diversity, IterPert-like; greedy = quality-only, NAIAD-like). trunc_known is the limit the learned rules chase.

Constrained acquisition ("+ per-round trunc"). The methods above truncate only at nomination. The greedy + per-round trunc / EHVI + per-round trunc / known trunc throughout variants additionally restrict each acquisition round to genes believed safe (predicted, or known for the upper bound) — so the assay budget isn't spent on genes we think are toxic. Acquisition and nomination are still distinct stages; this constrains both.

Diversity operators (Analysis B). • none: top-K by quality. • cap: ≤ c per CORUM pathway. • kdpp: quality-weighted k-DPP with a dense embedding-cosine (mechanism) similarity — never outcome similarity. Layered on three bases.

Toxicity & τ. • contrast (primary): lethality in one fixed contrast line (normal-tissue stand-in). • aggregate: common-essential fraction, excluding the target line. τ is a quantile: the dashed line on each plot is the τ-quantile of the candidate toxicity (τ=0.5 = the safest half) — for the contrast definition, quantile(−effect in the contrast line, τ).
Naive greedy carries toxicity 0.83 at efficacy 0.97. The known-toxicity ceiling (trunc_known) reaches toxicity 0.15 / efficacy 0.51; the learned ceilings (trunc_pred 0.31, EHVI+trunc 0.32) sit between — the gap to trunc_known is the price of learning safety from the embedding. (Untruncated EHVI baseline: tox 1.24.)

Toxicity definition: contrast (primary)

Each point a method (mean over lines × seeds, 95% CI bars). Up = more lethal, left = safer. Dashed line = the τ toxicity ceiling (quantile 0.5 of candidate toxicity).

For each method, how many of the K nominees have TRUE toxicity below (permissible) vs above the τ ceiling. The naive/diversity baselines nominate many over-threshold (toxic) targets; the safety rules keep them permissible.

A · Per-cell-line tradeoff

One panel per cell line; the same methods; each with its own τ ceiling. The safety ordering holds across lines.

Each panel a method. Grey = all candidate genes (pooled over 2 lines); open circles = that method's 30 targets; dashed line = τ ceiling. Safety rules pull picks left of the ceiling.
